content.short: Reitcircles is a decentralized RWA protocol on Cardano for fractional real estate ownership and liquidity.
content.description: Reitcircles is an innovative Real-World Asset (RWA) protocol leveraging the Cardano blockchain to democratize real estate investing. The platform allows asset owners to fractionalize their property, enabling small investors to purchase shares and access global liquidity. By utilizing REIT tokens with a supply model inspired by Bitcoin's halving, the project ensures transparency and long-term value. Reitcircles is also developing a regulated enterprise wallet to provide a compliant environment for both institutional and retail participants to secure their home equity on the blockchain.
content.meta: Reitcircles is a Cardano RWA protocol for fractional real estate ownership and regulated DeFi. Explore it on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
